title: PI scientific approval — reviewed reflectance comparison

payload.prompt: Approve the scientific findings for the exact CTR-54 revision identified in the PI submission?
payload.rejectReasonLabel: What should change, or why do you reject these findings?
payload.detailsMarkdown:
**Decision needed:** Approve the scientific findings at revision `7b9232da45c68c82c5f996b37357f15fb7b9ed55`.

**Why this matters:** The 22-acquisition comparison finds generally lower ACOLITE reflectance. Larger maps and your blue–white–red SD scale are complete; independent review found no major concerns. Missing quality flags and uneven sampling limit interpretation.

**My recommendation:** Approve this descriptive comparison with its documented limitations.

**Other options:** Request revisions or reject the findings, giving your reason.

**Consequences:** Approval applies only to the exact report and artifacts identified in the [PI submission](/CTR/issues/CTR-54#document-pi-submission). Manuscript integration, merge and publication remain separate decisions.

**Action requested:** Inspect the report and review file cards, then select Approve scientific findings or Request changes / reject.

The lab rules reserve this decision to the PI; the scientific-research-management skill requires an exact reviewed revision and an authenticated decision. Agent metadata is not approval.
